description: February 22 birthday meaning: Pisces decan 1, birthday number 22, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a February 22 birthday falls in Pisces, in the first decan, with Neptune as the sign's ruler and Neptune as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 22. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Pisces is mutable and water.

sections.heading: February 22 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Master number 22 is usually linked with grand, practical construction, which makes February 22 an intriguing case. The Sun sits around three degrees into Pisces, in the Neptune-heavy first decan. The tension is fruitful: a dreamer who can also build, often described as turning compassionate ideals into institutions, buildings or long-running creative projects.

On February 22 the Sun usually sits at about 3° Pisces, in the first decan, where Neptune rules the decan as well as the sign. Neptune, modern ruler of Pisces, also governs the sign's first decan, from about February 19 to February 28. This is often seen as the most dreamy and boundless part of the zodiac's final sign. Natives tend to be imaginative, compassionate and highly sensitive to music, mood and meaning. They may move through the world like a sponge, absorbing atmosphere and other people's feelings. Doubled Neptune can blur practical edges and make escape tempting when life feels harsh. Creative work, spiritual practice and caring roles often give this decan a way to channel what it senses.

sections.heading: February 22 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 22nd gives a birthday number of 22, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced. Sometimes called the Master Builder, 22 combines the 2's cooperation with the 4's practicality on a larger scale, suggesting an ability to turn big visions into working structures. Even in the secondary position of a birth day, it is given weight in numerology. People born on this day are often described as idealistic planners, capable of organising many people towards a shared goal. Pressure can come with that potential, so pacing themselves tends to matter a great deal.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one February 22 birthday to the next: it is 4 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 33 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 33.

sections.heading: Born on February 22: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 22 is the 53rd day of the year. By March 21, 28 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Aries.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by February 22, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on February 22 include George Washington (1732), Arthur Schopenhauer (1788) and Heinrich Hertz (1857).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 22?
faq.answer: February 22 is Pisces in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Pisces, which tradition links with Neptune.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 22?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 22 the Life Path is 4 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 33 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 22 for everyone born on the 22nd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 22?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a February 22 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 22?
faq.answer: February 22 is also the birthday of George Washington (1732), Arthur Schopenhauer (1788) and Heinrich Hertz (1857). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
